subject.title: Feature Request: Quota-based provider recommendations ("Which should I use next?")

question: Should CodexBar add cross-provider recommendations, and if so which comparison policy and first user-facing surface should define the supported contract?
rationale: The code can calculate percentages and pace, but it cannot determine whether unlike provider windows are comparable or whether recommendations may reorder a user's persisted menu without a product policy.

options.title: Narrow opt-in recommendation
options.body: Define eligibility and a transparent headroom/pace score, preserve manual ordering by default, and launch through one bounded surface before expanding.

options.title: CLI-only experiment
options.body: Add an experimental `codexbar recommend` result first so scoring can be evaluated without changing menu ordering or notification behavior.

options.title: Decline automated advice
options.body: Keep CodexBar descriptive rather than prescriptive and improve existing usage and pace visualization instead of ranking providers.

recommendation.title: Narrow opt-in recommendation
recommendation.body: Define eligibility and a transparent headroom/pace score, preserve manual ordering by default, and launch through one bounded surface before expanding.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes CodexBar's product role and menu behavior, and VISION.md assigns major UX direction to explicit project sign-off.
